notes.title: House Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
 A big update "House" in now live. The update allows players to buy a house and decorate it. Different colors, different decorations, and furniture for the house.
An update also brings a lot of bug fixes that I did not track of.

With all that being said, this is going to be the last major update for this game. There will be smaller patches fixing any discovered bugs but my next focus will be making a new trailer. Thank you all for your support and giving this game a chance.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
 I have been pushing some updates fixing any bug that I am aware of.
 Here is the list of bugs I fixed so far:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't pick up quest items
[*] Fixed a bug where some quest Items wouldn't show up
[*] Fixed a bug where Dates were not tracking properly
[*] Fixed a bug where Red and Green crystals weren't showing up
[*] Fixed a bug where Ancient Gate from Viking town wasn't interactable
[*] Fixed a bug where description of a quest was wrong
[*] Fixed a missing Sprite issues with quest items and Viking Town in teleport Station
[*] Fixed a Store LVL 2 where displays couldn't be placed at some places
[*] Fixed hitbox for the floor in Store LVL 2
[*] Fixed a bug where mining resources were not showing proper numbers
[*] Fixed a bug where Jewelry Display was not saving the item
[*] Fixed a bug where quest items were not being saved properly esp the Gate Keys
[*] Fixed a bug where you could interact with an Airship beg from the outside
[*] Added a marker to Loan Collector so you don't have to search for him
[/list]

These are the fixes I can think of, there are still some bugs I will be fixing in coming updates.

notes.title: Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
Hello,
 I want to communicate about upcoming updates and set the expectations for the future of this game.
In total there will be three major updates with features including but not limited to.

[h2]Home sweet home[/h2]
[list]
[*] Purchasing a house
[*] Upgrading existing house
[*] Modifying a house (wall paint color, windows, doors and etc.)
[*] Furniture for the house
[*] Furniture bonuses (MAYBE - if it effects the balance too much, then it won't be implemented)
[*] One more Champion
[/list]
[h2]The Shop Owner[/h2]
[list]
[*] Purchasing a new store from the list of shops
[*] Upgrading existing shop (wall paint color, windows, doors and etc.)
[*] Cinematics of Airship taking off and landing
[*] More Decorated Floating Islands
[*] Dungeons for Champions, instead of claiming champions at the gate you would have to visit their Dungeon.
[/list]
[h3]and (MAYBE) Elvish Lands[/h3]
Features TBD
